items.title: HP (HPQ) Stock May Be 42% Undervalued After Earnings Focus Returns

items.title: HP (HPQ) Brings Marketplace Intelligence Into Multi Jet Fusion Software
items.summary: HP (NYSE: HPQ) announced a new collaboration with Xometry to link its Multi Jet Fusion build optimization tools to Xometry's marketplace. The partnership integrates Xometry's job management and quoting capabilities directly into HP's 3D printing software workflow for production customers. HP plans to use Xometry's marketplace intelligence to inform part costing, material selection and production planning inside Multi Jet Fusion systems.
